source: Starter set of common Reel formats. Not yet checked against what is trending this week.

templates.name: Fast cuts on the beat
templates.about: 16 photos, hard cuts every 0.4 seconds. Pair with any upbeat trending audio.

templates.name: Slow build, then burst
templates.about: Three slow shots to set the scene, then 14 rapid ones. Works with audio that has a drop.

templates.name: Slow zoom highlights
templates.about: 7 of the best shots, 2.2 seconds each with a slow zoom. The whole photo stays visible on a blurred backdrop.

templates.name: Top 5, best last
templates.about: Five shots, 2.4 seconds each, building to the best one. Add the 5 to 1 numbers yourself in Edits.

templates.name: Stop-motion sequence
templates.about: One burst of action played as a flip-book and looped three times. Uses a sequence, not single shots.
